entries.clue: Capital where a nursery window was left open for a flying boy
Fist-sized pump driving blood on its endless circuit.
Humblest of the lost boys, who grows up to be a judge in a wig
Long heavy barrel that hauls a distant bird right into the frame
Stretchy bag that stores fluid until you find a loo.
Light-tight box that once needed only a pinhole and a plate
Stacked column of bones running down the back.
Hook's are a melancholy blue until two red spots light them in a kill
Bone of the lower arm on the side of the smallest digit.
Little one the lost boys built round Wendy where she lay
Blind that flicks open for a split instant, then seals out the light
